title: SkillContrast: Difference-Guided Text Selection for Agent Skill Reranking
title_zh: SkillContrast: Difference-Guided Text Selection for Agent Skill Reranking

paragraphs.en: Similar agent skills can share instructions but differ in their conditions of use. Query-based text selection may retain shared instructions and omit these distinctions. We introduce SkillContrast , a training-free selector that compares retrieved skills and retains their differing text with local context for a pretrained reranker. On 1,235 requests from SameCapRisk-Bench, it yields 54–72 more clean hits—requests that retrieve a helpful skill without its marked risky sibling—than TF–IDF query selection at identical per-candidate input lengths, across 2 retrievers and 2 reranker sizes. Length-matched component replacements identify differing text as the main contributor in the primary setting, with smaller, mixed context effects. Relative to full skill bodies, SkillContrast uses 51.1–58.8% fewer model-input tokens, with 10–18 fewer clean hits at 0.6B and matching or higher observed clean-hit counts at 4B. Candidate-relative differences thus complement query relevance in selecting compact reranking inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 类似智能体技能可以共享指令，但在使用条件上存在差异。 基于查询的文本选择可能会保留共享指令，同时忽略这些差异。 我们提出了 SkillContrast——一种无需训练的筛选器，它能比较检索到的技能，将其中不同的文本与局部上下文一同保留，供预训练的重排序器使用。 在 SameCapRisk-Bench 提供的 1,235 个请求中，与 TF–IDF 查询选择方法相比，SkillContrast 在相同候选输入长度下，通过两种检索器和两种不同规模的重排序器，获得了多 54–72 次干净命中——即成功检索到有用技能且未附带其标记为高风险的关联技能的请求。 在长度匹配的组件替换实验中，主要场景下差异文本被识别为主要影响因素，而上下文的影响则较小且混合存在。 与完整的技能主体相比，SkillContrast 使用的模型输入令牌减少了 51.1–58.8%，但在 0.6B 规模下干净命中次数减少了 10–18 次；而在 4B 规模下，其观察到的干净命中次数则相同或更高。 因此，相对于候选项的差异性能够补充查询相关性，从而帮助选择更紧凑的重排序输入。

paragraphs.en: Agent systems retrieve reusable skills from libraries hosted on GitHub and agent platforms ( Kang et al., 2026 ) . Several skills may serve the same purpose yet require different resources, preconditions, or input formats. Two migration skills, for example, may describe the same procedure but target different software versions. Both can look relevant to a request, although only one meets its conditions. We study how to make these distinctions visible to a reranker without passing it every candidate’s full instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体系统会从托管在 GitHub 和智能体平台上的库中检索可重用的技能（Kang 等人，2026）。 多种技能可能服务于相同目的，但需要不同的资源、前提条件或输入格式。 例如，两种迁移技能可能描述了相同的流程，但针对不同的软件版本。 两者都可能与请求相关，但只有其中一种满足其条件。 我们研究如何在无需向重排序器传递每个候选项的全部说明的情况下，使其能够识别这些差异。

paragraphs.en: Reading full skill bodies exposes information missing from short descriptions ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . To shorten the reranker’s input, a selector can instead choose passages—excerpts such as paragraphs or code blocks—by their query relevance ( Li et al., 2023 ) . Yet similar candidates may share the most query-relevant instructions while differing in a prerequisite elsewhere. We therefore ask: can comparing the candidates reveal useful reranking text that query relevance alone overlooks?
paragraphs.zh: 阅读完整的技能说明可以揭示简短描述中缺失的信息（Zheng 等人，2026）。 为了缩短重排序器的输入，选择器可以选择段落或代码块等选段，依据其与查询的相关性进行筛选（Li 等人，2023）。 然而，相似的候选项可能共享与查询最相关的说明，但在其他前提条件上却存在差异。 因此我们提出一个问题：通过比较这些候选项，能否发现仅凭查询相关性所忽略的、对重排序有用的文本？

paragraphs.en: We introduce SkillContrast , which compares textually similar retrieved skills and retains the blocks where their own instructions differ, together with opening and preceding context. A pretrained reranker then scores each candidate’s selected text against the request, without further training. Skills without a close neighbor use query-based selection. We use maximal marginal relevance (MMR) ( Carbonell and Goldstein, 1998 ) to balance these scores against redundancy when selecting the final list. Comparison chooses the text; the reranker judges its relevance to the request.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SkillContrast，它能对文本相似度高的检索技能进行比较，保留其自身说明存在差异的部分，以及开头和前面的上下文内容。 随后，一个预训练的重新排序器无需进一步训练，即可根据请求对每个候选项的选定文本进行评分。 没有邻近相似技能的技能则采用基于查询的选择方法。 在挑选最终列表时，我们使用最大边际相关性（MMR）（Carbonell 和 Goldstein，1998）来平衡这些评分与冗余性之间的关系。 比较环节负责选择文本；重新排序器则判断该文本与请求的相关性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on SameCapRisk-Bench ( Ding et al., 2026 ) , which tests whether top-3 results include a helpful skill without its marked risky sibling. This complements SkillRet’s large-library retrieval evaluation ( Kang et al., 2026 ) and R3-Skill’s study of joint compatibility ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Our matched-length comparisons show more clean hits with candidate differences than with TF–IDF query selection. Primary-setting replacements locate the main contribution in the differing text. Code and frozen-score table replay are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SkillContrast-92C8/ .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SameCapRisk-Bench（Ding 等人，2026）上进行评估，该基准测试前 3 个结果中是否包含一个有用的技能，而无需其标记的风险性关联技能。 这补充了 SkillRet 的大规模库检索评估（Kang 等人，2026）以及 R3-Skill 对联合兼容性的研究（Wang 等人，2026）。 我们的等长比较显示，与使用 TF–IDF 查询选择相比，使用候选差异能获得更多干净的匹配结果。 主要设置替换能够定位差异文本中的主要贡献部分。 代码和冻结得分表的重演版本可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SkillContrast-92C8/ 获取。

paragraphs.en: Agent skill retrieval. Voyager stores executable skills for retrieval and reuse ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , while ToolLLM retrieves APIs from a large tool catalog ( Qin et al., 2024 ) . These systems select reusable capabilities; our focus is which text from retrieved skill instructions reaches the reranker. Body-aware routing ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) and task-specific retrievers ( Kang et al., 2026 ) improve query–skill matching at library scale. Among plausible results, shared descriptions can still obscure suitability. This motivates query-conditioned compatibility supervision in R3-Skill ( Wang et al., 2026 ) and generic-content score calibration in SkillSight ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) . SkillContrast instead compares similar candidates to select their differing text for a frozen reranker. This exposes candidate distinctions without changing the retriever or training a new scoring model.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体技能检索。 Voyager 存储可执行的技能以便检索和重复使用（Wang 等，2024），而 ToolLLM 则从大型工具目录中检索 API（Qin 等，2024）。 这些系统会选择可重复使用的能力；我们的重点是：检索到的技能说明中，哪些文本能够进入重排序器。 身体感知路由（Zheng 等，2026）和任务特定检索器（Kang 等，2026）能够在库级规模上提升查询与技能的匹配度。 在多个看似合理的结果中，共享的描述仍然可能掩盖其适用性差异。 这促使了 R3-Skill（Wang 等，2026）中基于查询条件的兼容性监督，以及 SkillSight（Xiao 等，2026）中对通用内容得分的校准。 SkillContrast 则通过比较相似的候选项，选择它们之间的差异文本，输入到一个冻结的重排序器中。 这种方法无需更改检索器或训练新的评分模型，即可揭示候选项之间的区别。

paragraphs.en: Text selection for ranking. KeyB ( Li et al., 2023 ) selects query-relevant blocks using lexical or learned scores, while Provence ( Chirkova et al., 2025 ) prunes query-dependent sentences jointly with reranking. For similar skills, such selection may preserve shared instructions rather than distinguishing conditions. We compare equal-length, training-free selectors to isolate the effect of candidate comparison. List redundancy is a separate problem addressed by MMR ( Carbonell and Goldstein, 1998 ) and its probabilistic batch extension SMMR ( Liakhnovich et al., 2025 ) . We keep ordinary MMR fixed to isolate the selected text.
paragraphs.zh: 用于排名的文本选择。 KeyB（Li 等人，2023）通过词汇分数或学习得到的分数来选择与查询相关的文本块，而 Provence（Chirkova 等人，2025）则在与重新排序的同时剪除依赖查询的句子。 对于相似的技能，这种选择可能会保留共享的指令，而不是区分不同的条件。 我们通过比较长度相同且无需训练的筛选器，来孤立候选项比较所产生的影响。 列表冗余是一个独立的问题，由 MMR（Carbonell 和 Goldstein，1998）及其概率性批量扩展 SMMR（Liakhnovich 等人，2025）解决。 我们保持普通 MMR 不变，以孤立所选文本的影响。

paragraphs.en: We represent full skill bodies with TF–IDF ( Salton and Buckley, 1988 ) , connect candidates whose cosine similarity reaches 0.65, and compare them within connected components. TF–IDF uses lowercase unigrams and bigrams, with at most 160,000 features; it is fitted separately on each skill library. Grouping uses no benchmark family labels. Within each group, we align bodies line by line and map differences to paragraph and heading blocks, keeping fenced code intact. An insertion present only in another candidate selects adjacent text from the current candidate, never text copied across skills.

paragraphs.en: We first compare retrieval pipelines using each baseline’s own top-20 pool and MMR(0.75). paragraphs.en: To identify useful content, we replace differences, the opening block, or preceding context with equally long query-relevant text. We change only tokens belonging solely to that component; shared tokens remain, so replacing context cannot remove a difference. The BM25-selected control uses BM25 scoring ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) , adapting KeyB’s lexical selection ( Li et al., 2023 ) to our source units, input budgets, and reranker. Paired intervals use 10,000 bootstrap draws stratified by protocol over 410 benchmark groups (375 operation-contract, 10 source-role, 25 caller-interface), keeping dependent requests together. We report exploratory 95% intervals and Bonferroni-adjusted 98.75% intervals for the 4 primary CleanHit comparisons; adjusted intervals have limited tail precision.
paragraphs.zh: 为了识别有用内容，我们将差异、开头块或前文上下文替换为长度相同且与查询相关的文本。 我们仅更改完全属于该组件的标记；共享标记保持不变，因此替换上下文无法消除差异。 BM25选择的控制方法使用BM25评分（Robertson和Zaragoza，2009），将KeyB的词汇选择方法（Li等，2023）适配到我们的源单元、输入预算和重排序器中。 成对区间使用10,000次自助抽样，按协议分层覆盖410个基准组（375个操作-合同组、10个源-角色组、25个调用者-接口组），同时保持依赖请求的完整性。 我们对4项主要的CleanHit比较报告了探索性95%置信区间和经过Bonferroni校正的98.75%置信区间；校正后的区间尾部精度有限。

paragraphs.en: We next identify which content contributes to this advantage. Retaining differences gives a 6.32-percentage-point CH@3 advantage (exploratory 95% group-bootstrap interval: 4.47–8.16 points). paragraphs.en: Shorter model inputs do not guarantee a faster pipeline. We timed a single pass with the 0.6B reranker on the original benchmark data, rotating strategy order per request. Relative to full bodies, SkillContrast reduced online time by 10.4%, saving 76.8 ms per request. Timing covered input construction, encoding, 20 model forwards, and MMR. We compared 1,229 requests valid across strategies. Input validation rejected 8 of 3,705 records. Index and source-feature preparation cost 25.1 s and 135.0 s separately. GPU processes were sampled every second, with no other CUDA process observed. This single-pass measurement, with CPU exclusivity unverified, separates preparation cost from online reranking time.
paragraphs.zh: 较短的模型输入并不保证流程更快。 我们在原始基准数据上对 0.6B 重排序器进行了单次处理计时，每次请求都会轮换策略顺序。 与完整输入相比，SkillContrast 将在线时间减少了 10.4%，每请求节省 76.8 毫秒。 计时涵盖了输入构建、编码、20 次模型前向传播以及 MMR。 我们比较了在所有策略中均有效的 1,229 个请求。 输入验证拒绝了 3,705 条记录中的 8 条。 索引和源特征的准备分别耗时 25.1 秒和 135.0 秒。 GPU 进程每秒钟被采样一次，未观察到其他 CUDA 进程。 这种单次处理的测量并未验证 CPU 的独占性，因此将准备成本与在线重排序时间区分开来。

paragraphs.en: SkillContrast retains candidate differences with local context for a pretrained reranker. Across 4 SameCapRisk-Bench settings, it adds 54–72 clean hits over TF–IDF query selection at matched lengths. Primary-setting replacements identify differing text as the main contributor. It cuts model-input tokens by 51.1–58.8%, with 10–18 fewer clean hits at 0.6B and matching or higher observed counts at 4B.
paragraphs.zh: SkillContrast 为预训练重排序器保留候选项与局部上下文之间的差异。 在 4 种 SameCapRisk-Bench 设置中，与 TF–IDF 查询选择相比，它在相同长度下增加了 54–72 次有效命中。 主要设置中的替换能够识别出不同文本为主要贡献因素。 它将模型输入令牌减少了 51.1–58.8%，在 0.6B 模型上有效命中次数减少 10–18 次，而在 4B 模型上观察到的命中次数则相同或更高。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation uses skill text and benchmark annotations, without executing skills or testing agents on users. CleanHit excludes the marked risky sibling, not all unsafe candidates.
